title: Honest Intervals for Wasserstein Mediated Effects with an Unknown Atom-Continuous Gap
banked_reason: D0.5 typed BELOW NOVELTY FLOOR: paper_score_ceiling 6.5 < 7.4 caps tier at subfield; math PASS and four cited leaves verified, no in-scope improvement directive.
gap_reasons: The delivered result establishes matching calibration only for the specified binary-mediator, randomized, bounded-local-contrast model with separated atom masses, a shared support endpoint, and uniformly positive smooth continuous components. The original-record converse is an iterated local worst-case bound over free baseline directions, not a lower bound at each fixed baseline or scalar equivalence of the complete experiment; the framing preserves this distinction and contains no stale matched-result overclaim. The Gaussian optimizer extends protected-parameter test inversion from [Evans, Hansen and Stark](https://www.stat.berkeley.edu/~stark/Preprints/617.pdf), so its contribution is the weighted folded-Gaussian solution and mixed-support transfer rather than a general confidence-set framework. The package supplies an arithmetic algorithm and an exact uniform-density example but no executed calibration values, reproducible numerical certificates, or finite-sample coverage and length comparisons. Its narrow model and untested practical calibration constrain the projected journal score, while the proved uniform crossover, feasible attainment, and all-randomized local converse clear the field floor. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery discharged the uniform mixed-support transport expansion, certified folded-Gaussian interval game, data-only original-record attainment, and iterated local all-randomized converse; the unused curvature restriction was removed, enlarging the final density class to C1. The math reviewer passed and four cited leaves were verified, but the deterministic paper-score gate capped the typed novelty tier at subfield (6.5 below 7.4), despite the raw general referee suggesting field. No Lean formalization was attempted; two related-work prose findings remain unrepaired, and executed numerical calibration and finite-sample comparisons remain absent.
tldr: For the given causal stochastic mediated effect \(\Psi(P)=W_2^2(R_1,R_0)\), one data-only connected interval is uniformly asymptotically \(90\%\)-honest and attains the full randomized Gaussian expected-length constant. An original-record converse matches that constant after the prescribed local supremum over free mediator baseline directions, including both closed baseline boundaries. The scale is \(s_n=n^{-1}+g^2n^{-1/2}\), with elbow \(g_n\asymp n^{-1/4}\). The uniform cubic transport expansion, feasible nuisance learning and certified folded-Gaussian optimization cover fixed, shrinking and oscillating gaps. The primitive class requires only \(C^1\) densities with the public envelope and first-derivative bound.
gap: Fixed disconnected-support transport limits and positive-density limits do not supply a common small-effect mediation calibration when the atom gap closes and all outcome primitives are unknown. Generic optimal-confidence-set machinery does not justify transfer to arbitrary original-record intervals with a constrained baseline nuisance.
fill: The result joins a uniform mixed-support transport remainder, relative-scale pilot estimation, certified connected Gaussian calibration and a boundary-preserving original-record expected-length converse on the unchanged model.
